title: MedLang: A Medical-Native Programming Language for Computational Pharmacology
description: MedLang is an embedded Domain-Specific Language (eDSL) for computational pharmacology and medical modeling. This repository contains the original Rust-based prototype (2024-2025) that has been unified into the Sounio Programming Language as stdlib/medlang/. MedLang provides domain-specific constructs for PK/PD modeling, population analysis, and clinical trial design, with native support for uncertainty propagation through Sounio's Knowledge<T> types.
notes: This repository has been archived. MedLang is now part of Sounio Programming Language (https://github.com/sounio-lang/sounio) as stdlib/medlang/. All active development continues in Sounio.
